profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Kymeta Corporation
profile.summary: Software Engineer. Space Lover. Architecture Lover. Enthusiast in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and Finance. Optimist in Future.

positions.title: Software Engineer (via Protingent)
positions.description:
• Designed, integrated, and developed Python microservice embedded in Flat Pannel Satellite Antenna to monitor performance of Linux
operation system and all key processes under different software builds through time.
• Developed automation test suites to control RF instruments, monitor signals, and collect data from Creonic FPGA in the antenna.
• Developed wireless TCP/IP networking system which helps users remotely manipulate antenna systems on mobile vehicles.
• Developed data analysis tools to conduct statistical researches and extract KPI values from collected RF metrics data.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test (via EASI)
Software/Hardware Engineer (via H10 Capital)
positions.description:
•	Designed, integrated, and developed from scratch Automation Test Bench of Near Field Communication in Wireless Charging (WLC NFC) features for Surface devices as Surface Neo, Surface Neo Keyboard, Surface Slim Pen, Surface Pro X Keyboard, and to visualize RF field, verify WLC features, help drop verification time from months down to days, detect hardware and firmware bugs at precision of less than 50 microns and 10 microseconds.
•	Designed and developed from scratch test bench software architecture, Python APIs in OOP, and algorithms to simulate behaviors of WLC NFC in sensitive interaction between Transmitter (TX) and Receiver (RX), to operate the test bench at optimal run time, and to verify WLC test cases. 
•	Built Python automatic data analysis framework including collecting, visualizing, and summarizing data in real time.
•	Integrated industrial CNC, peripherals (servo, digital microscope), electrical instruments (Oscilloscope, Digital Multimeter, Power Analyzer, Electric Load, using SCPI language), embedded systems (Aardvark, and protocols of I2C, USB, RS232) , the automatic data analysis framework, test bench software, fixtures, and devices under test as a whole test bench.
•	Worked with multiple Microsoft Surface Device teams to build and develop test plans for WLC NFC. Executed test cases manually before transforming test cases into automation.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Managed Seattle Strong Cold Brew Coffee product quality and designs.
- Designed the logo

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineering (Internship/Research Assistant )
positions.description:
•	I worked on Embedded Systems in Elcano Project on self-driving tricycle in a large team which is diverse in culture and career majors.
•	I rewrote existing C and C++ codes in Elcano code library, and added Serial CRC Checksum technique to reduce electric noise and avoid digital errors in UART communication between Arduino boards with small jumper wires at accuracy of 100%.
•	I used OpenCV and wrote Python scripts embedded in Raspberry Pi to detect traffic cones by color, and automatically measure the distance between the cone and Pi camera at the accuracy of 98%. I generated formulae in the code by employing plane geometry and specifications of Pi camera to investigate the relationship of real-object size, object-image size captured by Pi cam, and the distance between object and cam.
•	I used Github to contribute the work to software team. I documented my work for Elcano document library.
•	I setup deadlines and used Wiki and Kanban in order to ensure my team’s plan, project plan, and other teams’ plans to be done on time before presentations to Elcano’s collaborators, and before competitions.

positions.title: UW Research Co-op
positions.locationName: University of Washington, Seattle, Washington, United States
positions.description:
•	I worked in small team on a co-op project offered by telecom company Tupl Inc. on Customer Tickets Classification. I quickly learned theories and skills in Data Science and Machine Learning to build project in order to catch up deadlines before demoing the product to Tupl Inc. ’s customers.
•	I used Data Science techniques (Zeppelin, Spark, SQL, MS Excel, Bayesian Classifier) to build a pipeline for cleaning the data set of 11000 customer responses to a telecom service.
•	I used Machine Learning techniques such as Deep Learning (RNN, CNN, TSNE, Word2Vec) and related tools (Spark, Python, Zeppelin, and Tensorflow) to build and train the model of analyzing sentiments, and automatically classifying the data set into 10 categories at precision of 76%
•	I finalized my work to integrate with the user interface (website and speech recognition) well done by other team members.
